pageBuilder.heading: Questions
pageBuilder.intro: Common questions about how variants work.

items.question: Can editors change the page layout?
items.answer: Yes. Pages are a list of blocks: editors add, remove and reorder them, and choose each block's layout option. They can't place things freely, which keeps every page on-brand.

items.question: When does the live site update?
items.answer: When you publish. A Sanity webhook calls a Netlify build hook and the static site rebuilds, usually in under a couple of minutes.

items.question: How do I add a new block?
items.answer: Add a folder to packages/blocks with its schema, component and query, register it in the index files, then list it in a variant's factory.config.ts.

pageBuilder.heading: How this site works
pageBuilder.body: This page uses the split hero layout and a rich text block. Swap in your own image and words in the Studio.

children.text: Create a Sanity project, copy apps/starter/.env.example to .env.local, and add the project ID. Then run pnpm seed to import this starter content into your dataset.

Open the Theme document in the Studio. Choose a preset, set a primary and accent colour, and adjust the corner radius and fonts. The preview above the fields shows the palette and flags any contrast problems.
Production is a static site. Publishing in Sanity triggers a webhook that rebuilds it on Netlify. A separate preview site shows drafts live while you edit.

pageBuilder.heading: Ready to launch a variant?
pageBuilder.body: Run pnpm factory:new my-site from the repo root.
